items.note: Diet-to-GVHD result whose microbial target is only 'the microbiome' (codebook 1.1). [130]

items.quote: Studies on the supplementation with resistant starch and GFO (glutamine, fiber, and oligosaccharide) have shown a reduction in the incidence and severity of aGVHD while preserving butyrate-producing bacteria

fields.evidence_as_stated: studies on supplementation with resistant starch and GFO
fields.mechanism_as_named: Prebiotics preserve butyrate producers and reduce aGVHD

items.note: Producer label with an outcome and no distinct downstream mechanism -> 1a (codebook 4, GUO_015). Prebiotic supplementation has no own intervention value, so 'diet' is used; evidence read as human interventional because patients were supplemented.

items.quote: a symbiotic mixture containing high levels of seven safe bacterial strains plus fructo-oligosaccharides in 21 allo-HSCT patients during 21 days prior transplantation, and it found the absence of any aGVHD signs (0% vs. 25% p = 0.047)
items.note: Interventional aGVHD result, but the target is an unnamed generic group ('seven safe bacterial strains'), which is not a microbial target (codebook 1.1). [139]

items.quote: On day 14 after FMT administration, 12 patients in the treatment group (52%) achieved permanent remission, compared to none in the control group.
items.note: FMT result with a whole-community target (codebook 1.1). [146]

items.quote: The FMT group also showed a restoration of microbiota diversity post-antibiotics and a reduction in the dominance of certain microorganisms, such as Enterococcus, Streptococcus, Veillonella, and Dialister.
items.note: FMT reduced these taxa, yet the same trial reported higher GVHD incidence in the FMT arm (separate sentence), so no direction can be assigned to them: the codebook's 'reduced by a successful therapy' test fails. [147]

items.quote: the specific contributions of bacterial groups such as Enterococci and Lactobacilli remain under investigation
items.note: Uncited conclusion with no direction and no specific GVHD finding; the underlying rows are captured from the body and Table 1. Promote as context-dependent for Enterococci and Lactobacilli if wanted.
